report.summary: Both failures are the same 5-second Page.goto timeout on /books, and the cause is timing rather than a broken page. The app's seeded slow_list bug adds a random 0-8 s delay to every book-list render, while the UI fixtures allow only 5 s, so these tests fail whenever the delay runs long. Do first: confirm whether BUGS=slow_list is set in the environment that produced this run (the paths point to a local Windows machine, and the CI workflow does not set it), then either unset it for the suite or make the list path fast or deterministic.

causes.title: Random server delay in book listing exceeds the 5 s UI navigation timeout
causes.explanation: With BUGS containing slow_list, list_books() sleeps random.uniform(0, 8) seconds on every call (app/main.py:160-161). render_books() calls list_books() (app/main.py:270), so every GET /books waits for that delay before responding. The UI fixture sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/ui/conftest.py:7), and BooksPage.open() calls page.goto('/books') with the default wait_until='load' (tests/support/pages.py:34). Whenever the random delay exceeds about 5 s (roughly 3/8 of runs), goto times out. The outcome depends on chance, so a rerun can pass. Both failing tests were the first to open /books in a short window and wait on that response. The other /books-opening tests in the same run (test_added_book_is_listed, test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui, test_deleted_book_disappears) passed, which fits random timing. The app is not broken: the fixture's /health check passed and the app started. The fixture (tests/conftest.py:31-42) only checks /health, so it never exercises the slow path.
evidence: Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:59814/books", waiting until "load" -> playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.
app/main.py:12 docstring: slow_list  random 0-8 s delay when listing books (flaky timing)
.github/workflows/tests.yml: no BUGS env var is set for the ui job, so the delay only appears where BUGS=slow_list is set.
causes.suggested_fix: First, check whether BUGS=slow_list is set in the environment that produced this run, and make sure CI does not set it. If the seeded bug is meant for triage only, run the UI suite without it. If the delay must stay, have the tests wait for the response without a 5 s cap (for example, raise the timeout for the /books navigation, or use wait_until='commit' and then wait for a page element with a longer timeout), or move the delay out of the request path. Re-run the UI suite several times with BUGS=slow_list to confirm the failures stop or become predictable.
